post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by merely changing macro_relief priority rank, macro thresholds, allocator top-N, notional, hold days, or cooldown on the same frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry needs closed forward allocator displacement rows, a materially new PIT macro-surprise/flow field, or a shared allocator parity implementation if this replay lead passes.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Macro relief was already an accepted standalone helper, but the allocator extension did not add enough incremental replacement value after existing higher-priority helper rows and global cooldown. The likely issue is overlap or sparse empty-day coverage rather than a bug in macro relief itself.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate-pool/allocation alpha: accepted macro relief event-clock stock leadership may add empty-day replacement value to the accepted helper allocator.
pre_run_questions.2_history_check: exp-20260606-020 accepted macro relief as a shared default-off helper; exp-20260610-004/005 accepted the allocator without macro relief. Broad macro proxy retries often failed, so the incremental confidence is moderate-low.
pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows; must beat the accepted exp-20260610-005 allocator aggregate and per-window EV/PnL deltas, with survival, drawdown, sample, and concentration guards passing.

prediction.confidence_reason: Macro relief is an accepted production-visible free official-calendar plus OHLCV helper and was not included in the accepted allocator. The test is conservative because macro relief is added at lowest priority, but broad macro proxy variants often failed and incremental sample may be small.

production_impact.parity_note: This runner changes no production code.
